title: Abafuni Benyaniso Abangalaliyo
intro: Khawucinge ngexesha apho inkolelo yayichaswa, kwaye iqela lemiphefumlo lakhetha ukuqiniseka okungenakugungqiswa kunokukhululeka kwehlabathi. Bejongene nokukhetha okunzima, bafuna indawo yokusabela, baqalisa uhambo olwakhokelela ebuthongweni obungaqhelekanga. Ibali labo lingqina lokukhuselwa nguThixo kunye namandla okholo nxamnye nokucinezelwa. Ngaba ungazibona ezi zinto zibalulekileyo?
clues: Sasiyindibano encinci, sidityaniswe lukholo olunzulu kuMdali omnye.
Sasiphila kwixesha apho umlawuli onamandla wayefuna ukunqulwa komnye umntu ngaphandle kuka-Allah.
Ukuze silondoloze ukholo lwethu, sagqiba ekubeni sishiye amakhaya ethu size sibaleke ingcinezelo.
Iqabane elithembekileyo, isidalwa sasemhlabeni, lasipheleka kolu hambo lwethu.
Sifumene indawo yokusabela kwindawo efihlakeleyo, apho uAllah wasibangela ukuba silale ubuthongo obunzulu, obude.
Xa sivuka, sasikholelwa ukuba kudlule usuku okanye inxalenye yosuku, kodwa iinkulungwane zazidlule ngokwenene.
arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
